svg.title: Mary, Queen of Scots: Abdication, Escape and Flight into England (1567–69)
svg.desc: High-precision 1:10m GIS historical atlas map of the Kingdom of Scotland and Northern/Midland England tracing Mary Stuart's sequential crisis from Kirk o' Field in Edinburgh (February 1567) to forced abdication at Lochleven Castle (July 1567), defeat at Langside (13 May 1568), flight across the Solway Firth to Workington and overland to Carlisle Castle (16 May 1568), Bolton Castle and the York Casket Letters Inquiry (October 1568), and custody at Tutbury Castle (February 1569).

text.tspan: (Infant James VI • Regent Earl of Moray, 1567)
Forced abdication (24 Jul 1567) & boat escape (2 May 1568)
Lands in England (16 May 1568) • Held at Carlisle Castle
Moray presents Casket Letters • Cecil’s ‘Not Proven’ verdict
Shrewsbury’s guard • Norfolk secret marriage plot
